test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is NOT a professional Indian Classical Dancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shreya Ghoshal**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shreya Ghoshal **is a playback singer in Bollywood and not a professional Indian Classical Dancer.
 
• Singer Shreya Ghoshal was born in India on **March 12, 1984 **in a bengali brahmin family.
 
• Her achievements were recognized with multiple awards, such as** five Filmfare Awards**, **seven Filmfare Awards South**, **four Kerala State Film Awards**, **two Tamil Nadu State Film Awards**,** two BFJA Awards**, and **five National Film Awards**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mallika Sarabhai:**

 
 
• She is the daughter of famous Indian scientist **Vikram Sarabhai.**
 
• She has also been involved in** activism and theatre**.
 
 
 
• **Vasundhara Doraswamy:**
 
 
• She has performed extensively in India and **abroad**.
 
• She has also **choreographed** dance productions.
 
 
 
• **Shovana Narayanan:**
 
 
• She has been recognized for her contributions to **Kathak.**
 
• She has also been a member of the** Rajya Sabha**, the upper house of the Indian Parliament.
